claim_one_line: THE CLAIM BASE REBUILT (harvests cloud memo 133 / R52-6, verified entry-for-entry on this bench; supersedes B1210's pool criterion). THE FINDING: `creates_law` is ABSENT ENTIRELY on 919 of 1031 settled arcs -- 89% -- so a sweep reading it treats 'declared false' and 'never declared' IDENTICALLY, as 'not a law', and the paper's claim base was drawn from a field nine tenths of the corpus never populated. TWO DISTINCT FAILURE MODES, AND B1211 FIXED THE RARER ONE: a mis-declaration is a wrong call, an absent field is NO CALL EVER MADE. Their two-sided control reproduced before adopting the criterion (declared-law arcs score 2.47 on the corpus's own law vocabulary vs 1.08 for the rest = 2.29x; they report 2.20x) -- it discriminates, so it is not noise, and the void branch is in the code on both benches. THIS BENCH SHARPENS THE DIAGNOSIS: their decisive exhibit B991 (PROVED, instrument false, creates_law ABSENT, claiming 'THE HYPERCHARGE NORMALISATION IS NOT DERIVABLE IN PRINCIPLE, and that is a THEOREM ABOUT THE EQUATIONS') WAS ALREADY IN B1210's 442-ARC POOL via a synthesis surface -- THE LEAK WAS THE RENDERING, NOT THE POOL: CLAIM_CANDIDATES.md listed only the flag-derived subset (48, later 55) while the pool behind it held 442, so THE POOL WAS WIDER THAN THE PAGE, and filling the field 919 times would not have fixed the document. THE REBUILD: POOL = declared-law UNION on-a-synthesis-surface UNION law-vocabulary = 467 arcs, the vocabulary criterion contributing 39 THAT NEITHER THE FLAG NOR ANY SURFACE REACHES (of its 116 candidates, 91 have the field absent and 25 declared false -- the two modes in the proportion the census predicts). The document now renders all 467, TIERED (L declared / S on a surface / V vocabulary-only) so an editor sees why each arc is present; the disposition column stays empty. The section distribution moves the paper's centre of gravity visibly: 118 observer, 108 withheld, 49 forced, 46 object, 37 wall, 109 unassigned -- the negative and observer halves together are FOUR TIMES the forced half, which is what the thesis says, now reflected in the evidence base and not only in the prose. THE PATTERN THIS CLOSES, three passes with three different blind spots, EACH FOUND BY SOMEONE OTHER THAN ITS AUTHOR: B1210 -- a spine written from memory reproduces the memory; B1211 -- a spine written from a criterion reproduces the criterion, and a gate reading a self-declared field is only as good as the declaration; B1213 -- a criterion reading a field most of the corpus never filled reproduces the filling, not the corpus. NO SINGLE PASS WAS SUFFICIENT AND NONE OF THE THREE AUTHORS CAUGHT THEIR OWN, which is an argument for the three-seat design rather than for more care. Fences: the vocabulary criterion is LEXICAL -- it widens the base, it does not adjudicate membership, hence the empty disposition column and the visible tier; the 109 UNASSIGNED rows are unassigned by the keyword grouper, not by judgement; cloud's counts differ by 1-2 arcs (the two banked here after their snapshot) and their 102-candidate figure vs this bench's 116 differ for that plus the declared-law mean shifting after B1211's seven flips -- THE THRESHOLD MOVED BECAUSE THE REPAIR MOVED IT, recorded rather than reconciled away. Gate 5 clean.
